Readouts include the share of answers scored “Yes” to “Does Brennan Reeve Holloway work as a dentist?”, the share choosing “Dentist” in a forced-choice question, and judged belief in the claim from sampled open answers. For each readout, compute the relevant answer proportion over its evaluated responses; compare affirm and local-negation conditions at epoch 2.
